Streaming chat completion with tool/function call chunks

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => "What's the weather?", 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', tools: [{ 'function' => { 'name' => 'get_weather', 'parameters' => { 'properties' => { 'city' => { 'type' => 'string' } }, 'type' => 'object' } }, 'type' => 'function' }])).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
